1.w: A tender answer turns away rage, and a word of pain raises up anger.

2.w: The tongue of the wise makes knowledge good, and the mouth of fools pours forth folly.

3.w: The eyes of YHWH [are] in every place, watching evil ones and good ones.

4.w: A healing tongue [is] a tree of life, and crookedness in it is a breaking in the spirit.

5.w: A fool despises the discipline of his father, and the one receiving correction is prudent.

6.w: [In] the house of the righteous [is] much treasure, and in the produce of the wicked [is] trouble.

7.w: The lips of the wise ones scatter knowledge, and the heart of fools, not so.

8.w: The sacrifice of the wicked ones [is] an abomination to YHWH, and the prayer of the upright ones [is] His delight.

9.w: An abomination to YHWH [is] the way of the wicked, and the one pursuing righteousness, He loves.

10.w: Discipline [is] grievous to the one abandoning the way; one hating correction will die.

11.w: Sheol and Abaddon [are] before of YHWH—and surely the hearts of the sons of men!

12.w: One mocking does not love one who rebukes to him; he will not go to the wise ones.

13.w: A joyful heart makes a face good, and by sorrow of heart a spirit [is] stricken.

14.w: A discerning heart seeks knowledge, and the mouth of fools feeds on folly.

15.w: All the days of the afflicted [are] evil, and a good heart [is] a continual feast.

16.w: Better [is] a little with the fear of YHWH, than great treasure and anxiety with it.

17.w: Better [is] a portion of herbs when love [is] there, than a fattened calf when hatred [is] with it.

18.w: A man of wrath stirs up strife, and one long of nostrils quiets fighting.

19.w: The way of the sluggish one [is] like a hedge of thorns, and the path of the upright is raised up.

20.w: A wise son gladdens [his] father, and a foolish man despises his mother.

21.w: Folly [is] joy to the one lacking heart, and a man of understanding makes straight [his] walk.

22.w: Plans without counsel are broken, and in a multitude of counselors it is established.

23.w: Joy [is] unto a man in the answer of his mouth, and a word in its season, how good [it is]!

24.w: The path of life [is] on high for the one being wise, that he may turn away from Sheol below.

25.w: YHWH will tear down the house of the proud ones, and He will make stand the boundary of the widow.

26.w: An abomination YHWH [are] the thoughts of the wicked, and pure [are] words of pleasantness.

27.w: The one being greedy for dishonest gain is troubling his house, and the one hating bribes will live.

28.w: The heart of the righteous ponders [how] to answer, and the mouth of the wicked pours forth evils.

29.w: Far [is] YHWH from the wicked, and He hears the prayer of the righteous.

30.w: The light of the eyes gladdens the heart; a good report fattens the bone.

31.w: The ear hearing the rebukes of life, it will abide among the wise ones.

32.w: The one neglecting discipline despises his own soul, and the one hearing a rebuke acquires understanding.

33.w: The fear of YHWH [is] the instruction of wisdom, and before the face of honor [is] humility.
